rationale: The original thesis was for an immediate breakout out of the tight consolidation below $21.64 while holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA. Instead, after 19 minutes, price has failed to break out, slipped below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($21.52) to $21.50, and is currently bidding right at the $21.48 invalidation level. With momentum stalling and the intraday consolidation base breaking down, closing now avoids unnecessary slippage on a likely stop-out, while strong session relative volume and holding well above VWAP ($21.28) make flipping short unattractive.
